TEXT:
[FI] The game project for the cultural festival is doing 
well, the Akagi siblings are on better terms. Finally, 
the countdown to boobs steadily approaches.

[FI] It appeared that everything around me is going 
smoothly.

[FI] However, with summer vacation nearing its end and 
the second semester of school starting up, the 
game production is at its climax on this certain day...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] ...So, if this cutscene is added here, it would be 
easier for players new to the RPG genre to 
understand it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Amazing! Makabe-senpai, you made that in such 
short notice?

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Not at all, I only ported bits and pieces from the 
collaboration with the club president, along with 
some of my programming.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] While it's up to you to make the contents 
interesting, I'll do all the back-end support I can.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] How reliable... Wonderful, Senpai!

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, don't praise me so much, it's embarrassing.

[FI] I casually sent an invitation, "Wanna check out at 
the club room?", but things are about to take a 
turn for the worse.

[FI] After seeing his lovely little sister and a guy talking 
like that, Akagi went berserk in an instant.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] It's him... I'm sure it's him...! I finally found him!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hey, what are you doing in front of our clubroom?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Kousakaaaaaa!!![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=28]Ahhhh!! Don't throw yourself at me while 
crying! That's creepy![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] But Sena-chaaaaaan!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Don't throw a tantrum, calm down. We completed 
phase one of Sena's situation, right? I even texted 
you with, "She doesn't have anyone she likes."

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah! Right after receiving your text, Sena gave 
me a present. It was a blissful moment, getting a 
gift from an angel♪

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah? That's good. Let's leave it at that then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not done yet, don't push me aside, 
Kousaka[font_size=23]a[/font_size][font_size=24]a[/font_size][font_size=25]a[/font_size][font_size=26]a[/font_size][font_size=26]a[/font_size][font_size=27]![/font_size][font_size=28]![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Ahh, geez! I got it, I'll tell you about what's going 
on, so stop clinging onto me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hello, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What's with that stare?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] All those stories, I had no doubt that they were 
merely her delusions, but... Senpai, you're really...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Of course not!! Stop backing away already, I'm 
begging you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] P-Please don't go embracing one another in public.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's no embrace! I was being grabbed by him.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] W-Whatever the case, I'll be in the club room. 
Please finish your lover's quarrel at once.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] What's this turn of events... This rotten ocean of 
misunderstandings is spreading far and wide 
around me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] Well you're a natural M, there's no avoiding it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]This is 100% your fault![/font_size] Get off 
me already! And why are you 
even here!

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] Ah yeah, let's continue from where we left off! 
Kousaka, you know me... I've been keeping Sena's 
present closeby, look!

[FI] Akagi pulls a game out of his bag. And don't keep it 
on your person, that's not a handheld game.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] And?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] But guess what... Sena was acting a bit weird that 
day. It was like her mind was in another place...

[FI] It was probably buried within the rotten ocean, 
knowing her.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] So that's why I'm asking, who the heck is this 
person?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who...? Ah, Makabe? He's a second year in our club.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] That's him! The pest that's been stalking Sena 
everywhere! I know it!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Huh? Didn't I resolve that issue for you? How long 
are you gonna keep this up?

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] As long as he lives, we're nowhere near a solution! 
He was talking to her earlier like they were close, 
that brat...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I don't know what you're going on about, but I 
have stuff to do in the club room. Have fun with 
your conspiracies. See ya.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT: [FI] His face and voice are nice, so it's gotta be him...!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Just how are you coming to that conclusion...

[FI] Ignoring Akagi's spouting of curses, I opened the 
clubroom door.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's up.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Kousaka-senpai, you're late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, something came up.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes, something...

[FI] As I sneaked a peek while pretending to look away, 
Kuroneko glared at me coldly. Thanks to Akagi, yet 
another annoyance surfaced...

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT: [FI] Well, the club president isn't here yet, so isn't it fine?

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Yo.

SPEAKER: SPK_PRESIDENT
TEXT: [FI] Ah, so everyone's here already?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yup.

SPEAKER: SPK_MAKABE
TEXT:
[FI] Huh? Don't we have one person too many? There's 
someone behind you two...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?

[FI] I followed my gaze towards where Makabe 
pointed, it was...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=44]Geh![/font_size]
[FI] Akagi! He followed me inside!
